problem: Being embarrassed by someone being filial and "too filial" makes no sense.
"那我们一样，我也很年轻" does not follow from the previous line.
A neighbor being "careful" every time you meet in the morning makes no sense.
English A2 says "neighbors" (plural) though the neighbor is a single person.
suggested_fix: With a neighbor this polite, it's comfortable living here.

problem: A company having hope only with polite employees is an odd claim for 客气.
努力变得很礼貌 is odd; effort to become polite as a work attitude is unnatural.
"有你这样的朋友，我会很客气的" is nonsense (a friend should make you less formal).
B answers an either/or question with 对.
suggested_fix: 不是，我爸妈说我从小就很{W}。

problem: B answers an either/or question with 对.
suggested_fix: 不是，我爸妈说我从小就很{W}。

problem: 资深 does not collocate with 朋友/人 as "an experienced friend you will see when you meet".
A kid being "experienced at school" makes no sense.
Prompt "Say that to you, your mom is..." is broken English.
suggested_fix: Say that in your heart, your mom is always this awesome.

problem: Prompt "Say that to you, your mom is..." is broken English.
suggested_fix: Say that in your heart, your mom is always this outstanding.

problem: 杰出 is written register for casually praising moms.
"人都很客气，压力也很大" - pressure does not follow from politeness.
Rational grandparents being hard to talk to and having reasons for being rational makes no sense.
Growing up abroad does not make people sensitive; the causal link is unnatural.
"红的价格" is awkward for "the price of red ones".
suggested_fix: 那我明天去商场问问红的多少钱。

problem: "绿的价格" is awkward for "the price of green ones".
suggested_fix: 那我明天去商场问问绿的多少钱。

problem: Green lanterns for Spring Festival that "look lively" does not fit; red is the festival colour.
"我很可惜" is ungrammatical; 可惜 describes the situation, not the speaker.
suggested_fix: 没办法，老板突然让我加班，真{W}。

problem: 太阳太强烈 is unnatural; 强烈 goes with 阳光.
suggested_fix: 今天阳光太{W}了，我们别出去了。

problem: "说得很充实 / 讨论得这么充实" is not natural Chinese for 充实.
"我已经冷了" is not natural; needs 很/死了.
"我不想冷了" is not natural.
suggested_fix: 好，我们快回家吧，我不想再这么{W}了。

problem: A asks about the hotel B is staying in, but B answers "I went to look" as if visiting.
Reply to a compliment says the kitchen gets clean when cooking, which makes no sense and does not answer the line.
A asks why the car is so clean; B answers "我也觉得" which does not answer.
suggested_fix: 我昨天刚洗过车，所以车里很{W}。

problem: Wanting to go and see a clean restroom is odd.
A says the supermarket is clean then goes to check; the three lines are not coherent.
Night market "warm" with "just how warm" makes no sense (needs 热闹 or 热).
English "more and more warm / more warm" is not natural (needs warmer).
English "more and more hot / more hot" is not natural (needs hotter).
温暖 school mixes temperature and atmosphere senses.
Avoiding the mall when it is less warm is illogical for 温暖.
English "even more hot than today" is not natural (hotter).
Warm weather leading to going home early makes no sense.
English "more and more warm" is not natural (warmer and warmer).
"这里天阴了" is ambiguous after B used 这里 for her own place.
Cloudy weather implying the park might be busy contradicts the logic.
Coming back if it stops being cloudy makes no sense.
"你别抱歉" is unnatural; people say 不用抱歉.
suggested_fix: 没关系，我没生气，你不用{W}。

problem: "有点耐心" reads as "has a bit of patience" and "怎么也不会耐心" is unnatural.
辛苦 means hard-working/toilsome, not tired; "有点辛苦吗/我也有点辛苦" is unnatural.
English "a bit more healthy" is not natural (healthier).
suggested_fix: Ha, honestly I just want to be a bit healthier.

problem: 看起来很辛苦 after asking whether she slept badly mixes tired with hard-working.
"你饱了吗/我还不太饱" is less natural than 吃饱了吗/还没吃饱.
"你今天快乐吗" is stiff; 快乐 as an everyday predicate is unnatural between friends.
"吃饭吧，大家都快乐" does not follow from the previous lines.
A1 says the results are already out, but A2 says "when the results come out".
A declares being really dissatisfied right after proposing to meet him first; contradictory.
suggested_fix: 那明天一起去认识他吧，也许是我太{W}了。

problem: English "feel/felt pleasant" is not natural (have a pleasant time).
"我只能不满" is unnatural.
suggested_fix: 说过了，可是没用，我只能一直这么{W}。

problem: English "felt so pleasant" is not natural (had a good time).
Prompt "ask him if it doesn't smell fragrant" is awkward.
suggested_fix: Say you are making soup and ask him if it smells fragrant.

problem: "香的味道" is awkward; 香味 is natural.
suggested_fix: 邻居今天做饭，楼里都是香味。

problem: A restaurant being "sweet" and everything on the menu being sweet makes no sense.
English "more sweet" is not natural (sweeter).
suggested_fix: Yeah, it's sweeter than last time's.

problem: English "the most sweet one" is not natural (the sweetest).
suggested_fix: Okay, you're treating, so I want the sweetest one!

problem: "新开的那家听说很甜" describes a shop as sweet with no noun; makes no sense as a restaurant.
English "more sweet / way more sweet" is not natural (sweeter).
English "a bit more light" is not natural (lighter).
English "eat more light" is not natural (eat lighter).
suggested_fix: Really? I'd like to eat lighter too. It's good for you.

problem: English "a bit more light" is not natural (lighter).
suggested_fix: I got used to it slowly. Now lighter food tastes good to me too.

problem: English "a bit more spicy" is not natural (spicier).
suggested_fix: I got used to it slowly. Now spicier food tastes good to me too.

problem: "所以不用担心，这样很明显" is a non sequitur.
"影响很具体" is awkward; 具体 does not describe an effect this way.
A natural introduction making one want to go and try it is a non sequitur.
"价格很现实" is an unnatural calque; people say 价格合理/实在.
"情况越来越合理 / 情况这么合理，大家都应该了解" does not hold together.
"技术很广泛" is unnatural; 广泛 goes with 应用/使用.
"关系正面" is not a Chinese collocation.
"关系这么自然，我也想多和大家合作" does not follow.
"说得客观，一点也不让人觉得累" does not follow naturally for 客观.
A rule being "objective for everyone" is unnatural (needs 公平).
Complaining that a coat is "too soft" (but colour OK) makes little sense; soft is positive for a coat.
Suggesting watching together a show that is "so fake" is illogical.
A "fake" kids' book is not a sensible complaint.
English "Does your family have few people?" is not natural (Is your family small?).
"明天朋友会少吗" is unnatural.
"来的人足够" has no stated purpose; enough people for what? Unnatural.
"这家店里的东西足够吗" makes no sense without a purpose.
"这附近的店足够吗" makes no sense without a purpose.
"学校的学生足够" makes no sense without a purpose.
充分 does not collocate with 房间 (needs 充足/有空房).
"机会充分" is not a collocation (机会很多/充足).
Slot gloss "rich" gives unnatural English "the menu is very rich" (varied).
English "plans are very rich / plans this rich" is not natural (packed/varied).
"有无限的想法，也要让他们说出来" is clumsy.
English "very huge" is ungrammatical (huge / really huge).
English "very huge" number is ungrammatical (very large).
English "very huge" is ungrammatical.
"准备的东西充分" is unnatural (needs 准备充分/够).
English "activities are so rich / this rich" is not natural.
"找菜不一样的" has wrong word order.
"不管意见类似" is ungrammatical; needs 是否.
suggested_fix: 不管意见类不类似，我们都要认真听大家说。

problem: "时间一致" is not natural for schedules matching.
A asked the question, so A saying "now much clearer, thanks" after B asked A to repeat is incoherent.
A convenient route is no reason to set off early.
"这件事比我想的方便多了…我们得慢慢来" does not cohere; 方便 does not describe 这件事.
"现代的活动" is vague and unnatural.
"现代的事情" is vague and unnatural.
"现代的地方" is vague; people say 现代化的.
"学个人的经验" is unnatural; experience is accumulated, not learned.
suggested_fix: 所以我们要多积累一些个人的经验。

problem: "原始的音乐" (primitive music) makes no sense as a hobby of casual friends.
"国际的艺术" is awkward.
"公共的房子" is not natural (public housing = 公共住房/公屋).
共同 means shared by parties; "共同的方法" as common ways is wrong.
"国际的生活" is not natural Chinese or English.
"实际的事情" as matters one will not discuss in public is vague and odd.
"国际的文化" is awkward.
"国际的地方住几天" is not natural.
A shows a scenic photo but says he went to a friend's place which is "especially beautiful"; mismatch.
"这个问题很新，问老师吧" is a non sequitur; a question being new is not a reason to ask the teacher.
English "new computers" (plural) does not match a single computer.
suggested_fix: I want to use a new computer.

problem: "坏的事" is not natural; Chinese says 坏消息.
"我觉得很着名" is odd (fame is a fact, not an opinion) and 着名 is a written form; 有名 is the spoken word.
A house does not look older at night; the logic (scary at night) belongs to another word.
"一直加班真的不奇怪，我们跟老板谈谈" is incoherent.
"I don't like good things" and "try good things" make no sense.
"公司也不太小" is a non sequitur after talking about the school.
English "Is your office near?" drops the home; should say home near the office.
suggested_fix: Is your home close to your office?

problem: "路真大 / 路大" is not natural; a road is 宽.
"房间宽" is not natural; rooms are 宽敞/大.
Offering to carry something because it is light, then telling her to carry it herself because it is not light, is illogical.
B said it is not near, so "近也没关系" is illogical.
suggested_fix: 我周末去看你吧，不近也没关系。

problem: English "eat too slow / eat really slow" uses the adjective as an adverb; not standard.
English "The bus came so slow" uses the adjective as an adverb.
English "walks so slow" uses the adjective as an adverb.
English "drive this slow / drives so slow" uses the adjective as an adverb.
"今天的课太久" is not grammatical; 久 needs a verb (课上得太久).
suggested_fix: 你觉得今天的课上得太{W}了吗？

problem: "服务真快速" is stiff; 快速 is attributive/adverbial, people say 服务真快.
English "how rapid the new coworker is" is not natural for a person (quick/fast).
English "handle it in a very rapid way" is awkward (promptly).
English "has grown so rapid" is ungrammatical (rapidly).
suggested_fix: The company has grown so rapidly in recent years, and everyone is happy.

problem: "这个动作要是不清楚，后面会有很多问题" is odd for 动作 in a discussion.
English "your movement while dancing" is unnatural (moves).
"贡献很好" is not natural; 贡献 is 大/很大.
suggested_fix: 他在这个项目里的贡献很大。

problem: "做爱好" is not a collocation (hobbies are not done).
"没有简单的答案" about hobbies is an odd abstract chat topic.
English "hear about it" for hearing a joke is wrong (hear it).
suggested_fix: Yes, I have a joke. Do you want to hear it?

problem: English "tell me about your joke" is wrong (tell me your joke).
suggested_fix: Of course I do. Come on, tell me your joke.

problem: "多找一些主意" is unnatural; ideas are thought up (想主意).
suggested_fix: 那我们明天开始想办法，多想一些{W}。

problem: "我们现在的展览不够 / 多找一些展览" makes no sense for friends chatting.
English "so much temper / a lot of temper" is unnatural (bad temper).
"这个的特点比那个好多了 / 我最重视特点" - a feature is not good/bad in itself; incoherent.
"喜欢日记" is odd; people like writing a diary (写日记).
English "let's do this condition first" does not match 先看.
suggested_fix: Okay, let's look at this condition first and then talk about the rest.

problem: "你喜欢这个条件吗" is slightly odd.
"只要商业差不多" is unnatural; 商业 is not 'how business is doing'.
"现在的商业不太好" is stiff; people say 生意/经济不好.
"这种东西的商业越来越大" is unnatural (needs 市场).
"以后的商业会不会有变化" is vague and stiff.
行销 is Taiwanese usage; mainland says 营销.
"在农业工作" is unnatural; say 做农业/从事农业/务农.
suggested_fix: 我家乡的人大多都在做{W}。

problem: Competitiveness cannot be "prepared early" or "given" by the boss; nonsense.
"寺庙里有很多传统" is odd.
"有福" as a New Year wish is not natural (福气/全家幸福).
English "lots of taboo / matters in taboo / attention to taboo" - uncountable gloss; needs taboos.
"这在忌讳里很重要" is awkward.
English "a lot of taboo" is not natural (taboos).
English "cultures" plural is unnatural for 文化的事; also the Chinese is vague.
"不能太相信信仰" is tautological (believing in faith).
English "pay special attention to taboo" is not natural (taboos).
Zodiac signs seen "everywhere at meals" and "these zodiac signs" with no referent make no sense.
"这些宗教" has no referent and "吃饭…到处都能看到宗教" is odd.
"你的兴趣有点不一样" is incoherent and does not match the English "a change in your interest".
English "your interest" singular is unnatural for talking about interests.
"你今天的压力怎么样" is an odd opener.
Asking "what's wrong" then asking to hear about her interest makes no sense.
"工作的时候我很注意自己的兴趣" and others seeing your interest are odd.
"照顾好自己的压力" is unnatural (处理好压力).
"问问情绪" is unnatural.
"每个人的意识不一样 / 找到适合自己的意识" makes no sense.
"找到适合自己的心情" makes no sense.
"意识就会慢慢变好 / 希望很快就有意识" is unnatural (有意识 means conscious).
"大家的意识越来越强" needs a modifier (e.g. 环保意识); vague as is.
情感 is stiff for casual friends talking about current feelings.
"它给了我很多情感" is not natural.
"给了我很多印象 / 有很多印象" is not natural; impressions are left (留下印象).
English "do you have an opinion / I don't have any opinion" misses the 'objection' sense of 意见.
English "any opinion" for 意见 (objection) is unnatural.
"大家一起看看想法" is odd; 听听你的想法.
suggested_fix: 没关系，先说出来，大家一起听听你的{W}。

problem: "每个人的概念都不同 / 听听你的概念" is not natural for opinions; 概念 is a technical concept.
"你刚才说的说法" is redundant.
suggested_fix: 对不起，我不太同意你刚才的{W}。

problem: "每种概念都有人相信" is unnatural for 概念.
English "other people's viewpoint" should be plural.
English "other people's opinion" should be plural.
言论 means public statements; "了解一下言论 / 这件事的言论" is not natural for an opinion about a decision.
"认真对待言论 / 言论背后" is stiff and unnatural for casual friends.
"看看能不能有看法" is unnatural.
"每个人的言论都不一样 / 把自己的言论说清楚" is not natural; 言论 is not a personal opinion.
"那个言论" is awkward; 那番言论.
B never gives her name, yet A says "这个名字很好听".
"你的年纪看起来很年轻" is unnatural; say 你看起来很年轻.
suggested_fix: 三十岁吧，你看起来很年轻。

problem: English "other people's age" should be ages.
"写好后再看看职业" (check your profession) is a non sequitur.
"少写了一个字" for a number should be 一个数字.
suggested_fix: 你再看看号码，有没有少写了一个数字？

problem: Moving house does not require changing your number at the bank; the module is about an address.
"很多人喜欢的形式" is vague and unnatural without a noun.
Complicated vs simple colours is an odd way to talk about colour.
"这家店的造型太多了" is unnatural; shop 款式 or styles.
"这个饭馆的组合" is not natural (set meals are 套餐).
"色彩太黑 / 白色的色彩" is not natural; 色彩 is not a colour name.
"什么造型的手机" is unnatural for phones (款式).
An event with "different styles" to choose to attend does not make sense for 风格.
English "Ask more questions. ability improves slowly." has a lowercase sentence start from the gloss.
suggested_fix: Ask more questions. Ability improves slowly.

problem: "支持孩子的能力" is unnatural.
"技巧比我们多多了" treats 技巧 as countable; unnatural.
"学心理 / 心理对生活有帮助" should be 心理学.
English "Yes. psychology helps" has a lowercase sentence start.
suggested_fix: Yes. Psychology helps with both life and work.

problem: "想有技巧" is unnatural (想掌握技巧).
Companies wanting a young man because of his 眼光 (judgment) does not fit; sounds like ability.
"想起小时候的记忆" is redundant (想起小时候的事).
Exam nerves depending on memory, and good memory meaning less nervous, is a non sequitur.
"眼光不错，就是有时候太紧张" - nervousness is unrelated to judgment.
Buying a house needing "ability" and "不能随便决定" do not match well.
English "the restriction there / varies" should be plural restrictions.
条例 is a narrow official term; "没有条例社会就会乱" is stiff.
"草案还在处理中 / 处理你的草案" is not natural for a draft proposal.
A school's strict rules do not explain a friend failing to get in (admission).
A school's strict 规范 explaining why a friend could not get in is weak.
"一个人旅行很有自由" is unnatural; say 很自由.
"自由会越来越好" makes no sense.
"医生说没事" contradicts a life-and-death remark, and "照顾好自己的生命" is unnatural.
生命 used for 生活; "你的生命有变化吗 / 生命比以前方便" is wrong.
Being too busy at work means "no luck at all" is a non sequitur.
"改变一个人的生涯" for a teacher is odd; 生涯 means a career arc.
"享受这样的命运" is unnatural.
事实 treated like a piece of news ("那个事实我昨天才听到") is odd.
"你说的事实，我不太相信" is contradictory; a fact is true by definition.
Gloss "condition" gives misleading English ("this condition"); should be situation.
